en: Aisha bint Yusuf ibn Ahmad al-Ba'uniyya
tr: Âişe bt. Yûsuf b. Ahmed el-Bâûniyye
ar: عائشة بنت يوسف بن أحمد الباعونية

description.tr: Modern öncesi dönemde Arap edebiyatının en üretken kadın yazarı — tasavvuf, şiir ve Kur'an ilimleri üzerine en az 12 eser yazdı || Dımaşk'ın bilgin Bâûnî ailesinden geldi. Alışılmadık biçimde karma izleyicilere ders vermesine izin verildi. || [Tarih notu] Th. Emil Homerin'in çalışmaları eserlerini modern ilgiye kavuşturdu.
description.en: The most prolific female author in Arabic literature before the modern era — wrote at least 12 works on Sufism, poetry, and Quranic sciences || She came from the scholarly Ba'uni family of Damascus. Unusually, she was permitted to teach mixed-gender audiences. She received ijazas from leading male scholars and held Sufi teaching authority in both Damascus and Cairo. || [Historiographical note] Th. Emil Homerin's scholarship has brought her work to modern attention. Her example challenges the assumption that women were excluded from Sufi intellectual discourse.
description.ar: أغزر مؤلفة في الأدب العربي قبل العصر الحديث || جاءت من أسرة الباعوني العلمية الدمشقية
